text:

author: Gwen Woodall
text: I called these folks on Thursday and they came on Friday to pump out our septic tank.  The pricing was upfront!  They are very affordable!  The job was done without any problems.  I highly recommend Swafford septic service!!

author: michael sagraves
text: Friendly, knowledgeable and thorough… these guys were total pros and they are our neighbors! I would not hesitate to recommend Swafford to anyone needing septic service.

author: Mckenna Goins
text:

Highly recommend Swafford Septic! They were quick to respond, arrived on time, and got the job done right the first time. Honest, professional, reasonably priced, and great to work with. If you need septic service, pumping, or repairs, you can’t go wrong with Swafford Septic!

author: kim quillman
text: I called yesterday to see about them coming out, they were at my house first thing next morning. The 2 gentleman that came were exceptional very nice polite and very knowledgeable. From pulling in my driveway and driving back out was only 45 minutes. Will be using them every time!! Thank you to all of you!!
